content: Elihu u mɑɑ ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: bɛɛ be i bwisi mɔ, i nɛn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑkio.
Bɛɛ be i lɑɑkɑri mɔ, i swɑɑ tem kpĩiyɔ i nɔ.
Domi swɑsɑ su rɑ ɡɑrin dobu wunɑnɛ,
nɡe mɛ yɑrɑ yɑ rɑ dĩɑnun dobu wunɑnɛ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i de su ɡem kɑsu,
kpɑ su ɡiɑ bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ ye yɑ wɑ̃.
Domi Yoobu u nɛɛ, u dɛɛre.
U mɑɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔ ku rɑ win dɛɛrɑ te ɡɑrisi ɡɑ̃ɑnu.
Kɑ win ɡem kpuro, u nùn ɡɑrisi wee kowo.
Bɑɑ mɛ u ǹ tore, u nùn mɛɛrɑ kuɑ ye yɑ ǹ kpeemɔ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i tɔnu wɑɑre nɡe Yoobu
wi Gusunɔn yɑɑko kobu kun kɑ sɛ̃ nɡe nim nɔrubu,
mɑ u kɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu sĩimɔ, u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ be sɑnnu?
Domi u nɛɛ, wi u kɑ Gusunɔ sĩimɔ,
u ku rɑ yen ɑrufɑɑni ɡɑɑ wɑ.
Bɛɛ be i bwisi mɔ, i nɛn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑkio i nɔ.
I n yɛ̃ mɑ Gusunɔ ku rɑ kɔ̃sɑ ko.
Gusunɔ Dɑm kpuroɡii u ku rɑ tɔnu win ɡem bire.
Adɑmɑ u rɑ tɔnu kɔsiewɑ ye u kuɑ.
Kpɑ u bɑɑwure nùn win dɑɑn ɑre wɛ̃.
Kɑ ɡem Gusunɔ ku rɑ kɔ̃sɑ ko.
U ku rɑ tɔnu nùn win ɡem bire.
Wɑrɑ u nùn woodɑ wɛ̃ u kɑ tem kpɑrɑ.
Wɑrɑ u nùn mɛ kpuro nɔmu bɛriɑ.
Gusunɔ ù n dɑɑ win tiin bwisikunu mɔ̀n nɑ,
mɑ u wɛ̃siɑru wunɑ te u tɔnu wɛ̃,
tɔmbu kpurowɑ bɑ koo ɡbi sɑnnu,
kpɑ bu ɡɔsiɑ tuɑ.
Yoobu, ɑ̀ n lɑɑkɑri mɔn nɑ, ɑ ɡɑri yi swɑɑ dɑkio,
yi kon nun sɔ̃.
Gusunɔ ù ku rɑ ɡem kɑ̃n nɑ,
u koo kpĩ u hɑnduniɑ kpɑrɑ?
Kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ wi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Dɑm kpuroɡii tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃?
Kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ sinɑ boko sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, u ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɑ̃ɑ,
kpɑ ɑ win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu soku tɔn kɔ̃sobu?
Adɑmɑ Gusunɔ u koo kpĩ u ko mɛ.
Domi u ku rɑ sinɑmbun bɛɛrɛ mɛɛri.
U rɑ ɡobiɡibu kɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu ɡɑrisiwɑ tiɑ.
Domi wiyɑ u be kpuro tɑkɑ kuɑ.
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru be kpuro bɑ koo ɡbiwɑ subɑru sɔɔ.
Gɑsɔ, wɔ̃ku suunu sɔɔrɑ ɡɑbɑ koo ɡbi.
Gɑsɔ, bɑ koo sinɑ boko seesi bu ɡo n kun sɛ̃sie.
Domi Gusunɔ u rɑ n tɔmbun sɑnu sɑnusu mɛɛrɑ.
Kpɑ u n ben swɛɛ nɔni ɡirɑri.
Yɑm wɔ̃kuru ɡɑru sɑri
te tɑ koo tɔn kɔ̃so bere u kun kɑ nùn wɑ.
N ǹ tilɑsi Gusunɔ u kɑ tɔnu siribu soku
u sere nùn siri.
U rɑ dɑmɡibu yɑrewɑ ben ɑyerun di sɑɑwɑrɑ sɑri.
Kpɑ u ɡɑbu kɔsire ko mi.
Domi u ben kookoosu yɛ̃.
U rɑ bu surewɑ wɔ̃kuru, kpɑ u bu kɔsuku.
U rɑ bu sɛɛyɑsiewɑ nɡe tɔn kɔ̃sobu tɔmbu kpuron wuswɑɑɔ.
Domi bɑ wi, Yinni Gusunɔ biru kisi.
Mɑ bɑ win woodɑbɑ yinɑ.
Bɑ derɑ sɑ̃ɑrobɑ wuri mɔ̀ sere u yi nɔɔmɔ.
Mɑ win lɑɑkɑri yɑ wurɑ wɔnwɔndobun mi ɡiɑ, ben wuri yin sɔ̃.
Gusunɔ ù n nɛɛ, u ǹ ɡoo ɡɑ̃ɑnu kuɑmmɛ, wɑrɑ koo nùn tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃.
Ù n tii beruɑ wɑrɑ u koo kpĩ u nùn wɑ.
Bweseru ɡɑru sɑri te tɑ koo kɑ tii yinɑ ù n tu sunɔ kɔ̃so wɛ̃ wi u koo tu dɑm dɔre.
Yoobu, ɑ wunɛn durum tuubɑ koore Gusunɔn mi?
A nùn sɔ̃ɔre mɑ ɑ ǹ mɑɑ durum mɔ̀?
A Gusunɔ bikiɑre u nun wunɛn durum sɔ̃ɔsi ye ɑ ǹ wɑ kɑ tii?
À n mɑɑ torɑnu ɡɑnu koore,
ɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔre mɑ ɑ ǹ mɑɑ nu mɔ̀?
Wunɛ wi ɑ Gusunɔ tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ,
ɑ tɑmɑɑ u koo tɔnu siri nɡe mɛ ɑ kĩ?
Wunɑ kɑɑ ɡere, n ǹ mɔ nɛ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ ɡerumɑ ye ɑ bwisikɑ.
Bwisiɡii be bɑ lɑɑkɑri mɔ, bɑ koo nɛn ɡɑri wurɑ bu nɛɛ,
Yoobu u ɡɑri ɡerumɔwɑ yi u ǹ yɛ̃.
Domi win ɡɑri yi ǹ ɑsɑnsi mɔ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i win ɡɑri kpuro wɛ̃ɛrio,
domi u ɡɑri mɔ̀wɑ nɡe tɔn kɔ̃sobu.
U win durum sɔɔ durum sosimɔ.
Domi u Gusunɔ seesimɔwɑ win ɡɑri ɡerubu sɔɔ,
u nùn yɛ̃ɛmɔ bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ.

content: Tɔnu u koo kpĩ u nɛɛ, u dɛɛre Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ?
